about: The Sun's color grade, per SDO layer: Robert's hearted presets from tools/sun-quality.html (the-signal), 2026-10-13. v2, kept for reference; assets/sun-grade.json (v3) is the one in use. One file, the same bytes in the-signal (assets/sun-grade.json) and meditatewiththesun (site/assets/sun-grade.json); change it in one, copy it to the other.
math: Per layer, on its tile of the mosaic (0..1 per channel), in this order:
3. elevate: x = min(c, 1); c = x + 0.25 * elevate * sin(pi * x)^2  (black and full white unmoved, mid grey lifted most)
5. saturation: l = dot(c, (0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722)); c = max(mix(l, c, saturation), 0)
6. c *= the layer's Atmosphere gain; the layers sum as light, then clamp to 1
